run_motion_planner: run the SE2 motion planner to compute an optimized collision-free trajectory using Levenberg-Marquardt optimization
create_trajectory_dataset: create a TrajectoryDataset from the motion planning 2D data directory for use with a DataLoader
initialize_straight_line_trajectory: initialize optimizer variables from a straight line trajectory between start and goal poses
get_optimized_trajectory: get the optimized trajectory solution after running the planner layer forward pass
generate_trajectory_figures: generate matplotlib figures visualizing planned trajectories with signed distance fields and robot radius
